title: Official Arabic statutory article
description: One article of the OFFICIAL Arabic statutory text of the Saudi Companies Law, ingested from an official government / official-gazette source. This is the FUTURE CANONICAL legal source. `official_text_ar` must be the verbatim official Arabic statutory text of the article as published — it is NOT a summary and NOT a reconstruction. A record must not set verification_status to `verified_against_official_gazette` unless it has actually been checked article-by-article against the official gazette source recorded here. `additionalProperties` is false.

law_id.description: Stable identifier for the law, e.g. 'sa-companies-law-m132-1443'.

article_number.description: Official article number (the Saudi Companies Law has 281 articles).

article_title_ar.description: Optional official Arabic article heading, if the official source provides one.

official_text_ar.description: VERBATIM official Arabic statutory text of the article from the official source. Not a summary, not a reconstruction, not machine-generated.

source_authority.description: Issuing / publishing authority, e.g. official gazette 'Umm Al-Qura (أم القرى)' or the Bureau of Experts at the Council of Ministers.

source_publication.description: Publication descriptor for the official source packet the article was extracted from.

royal_decree_number.description: Royal Decree number of the instrument, e.g. 'M/132'.

royal_decree_date_hijri.description: Royal Decree date in the Hijri calendar, e.g. '1443/12/01'.

official_gazette_name.description: Name of the official gazette, e.g. 'Umm Al-Qura (أم القرى)'.

source_url.description: Optional URL of the official source (should be an official government / gazette URL, not an unofficial copy).

source_file.description: Optional path to the official source file registered in the repository source packet.

extraction_method.description: How official_text_ar was obtained from the source, e.g. 'official_text_layer', 'manual_transcription_from_official_pdf', 'ocr_of_official_scan_then_manual_correction'.

verification_status.description: Verification state. 'verified_against_official_gazette' may ONLY be used after a real article-by-article check against the recorded official source.

manual_review_status.description: Whether a human has reviewed this record.

text_hash_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of official_text_ar (UTF-8), used to detect drift and to prove the verified text is unchanged.

notes.description: Free-text notes, e.g. amendment/version notes or reviewer remarks.
